property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract reverts when given an empty _tos array (length == 0); the mutant that changes require(_tos.length > 0) to >= 0 allows empty _tos and therefore does not revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Change require(_tos.length > 0) to require(_tos.length >= 0) so calls with empty _tos (length 0) no longer revert.
